6436a38f2e5e1e85.description: About Alfanar Projects Alfanar Projects, headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is a diversified company with operations spanning construction, manufacturing, and engineering services across the Middle East and other regions. The company is involved in electrical, electromechanical, and civil engineering construction, as well as the manufacturing and marketing of electrical construction products and allied engineering services. Alfanar Construction, a Grade I contractor in Saudi Arabia, operates as an Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company focusing on the Energy, Infrastructure, and Engineering Services sectors. Role Overview Alfanar Projects is seeking a Receptionist to join their team in Al Jubail. This is a full-time position suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. The role involves supporting various teams and ensuring effective communication and execution of planned activities. Execute planned activities to meet operational and development targets according to delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time parameters. The company is involved in electrical, electromechanical, and civil engineering construction, as well as manufacturing and marketing electrical construction products and allied engineering services. alfanar Construction is classified as a Grade I contractor by the Contractors Classification Committee of the Government of Saudi Arabia, specializing in Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) across energy, infrastructure, and engineering services sectors. Role Overview alfanar is seeking an Electrical Engineer to join its team in Riyadh, Central Region. This full-time position is designed for professionals with 0-1 years of experience. The primary purpose of this role is to plan, organize, and control electrical activities within projects, ensuring successful completion in accordance with established schedules, budgets, and Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) policy constraints set by the Project Manager. Key Responsibilities Review project electrical documents, including methodology, quality assurance, control procedures, engineering, and construction time schedules. Prepare and review technical submittals such as designs, specifications, drawings, calculations, method statements, TPIs, and risk assessments for compliance with client, authority, and end-user requirements, as well as local and international standards. Oversee and inspect site installation work daily, witness tests, identify non-compliance with construction documentation, and recommend corrective measures. Coordinate daily with the Team Leader and other team members to verify, document, and report quality issues of work performed by sub-contractors, and suggest corrective actions. Ensure all construction activities at the site run efficiently and review progress. Conduct technical meetings and maintain constant follow-up with Client Design and Engineering Divisions. Maintain the quality standards of all electrical activities as per the project quality plan. Accountabilities and Leadership Train subordinates and build an effective team. Provide leadership, coaching, and direction to subordinates in all aspects of their work. Delegate assignments to subordinates. Ensure fair distribution of tasks to maintain morale and motivation among subordinates. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets according to delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time parameters. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Resolve related problems and escalate complex operational issues. Ensure quality requirements are met to develop effective quality control and processes, including specifications for products, processes, or related activities. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with relevant policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within the defined area of work activity. The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

648ce0f3c48c0699.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تقييم تطور الحالات وفاعلية العلاج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى الطبيب الاخصائي مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان تقديم رعاية صحية متكاملة ودقيقة للمرضى. تشمل هذه المهام: أخذ السيرة المرضية المفصلة من المريض وذويه لدراسة الحالة المرضية بشكل شامل. إجراء الفحص السريري الدقيق وطلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية عند الحاجة. قراءة وتفسير نتائج الفحوصات والتقارير لتشخيص الحالة المرضية بدقة ضمن مجال التخصص. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها بانتظام. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية وفاعلية الخطة العلاجية المتبعة. إعداد وتوثيق التقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمرضى وحفظها وفقاً للإجراءات المتبعة. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: شهادة جامعية في الطب مع تخصص في المجال المطلوب. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التخصص. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتفاعل مع المرضى وذويهم. بيئة العمل يعمل الطبيب الاخصائي ضمن فريق طبي في عيادات صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. نشجع المرشحين المؤهلين على التقديم لهذه الفرصة المهنية في مجال طب الأسنان.

64fcee39e63d25bf.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في عنيزة، القصيم. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تقييم تطور الحالات وفاعلية العلاج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية الشاملة من المريض وذويه ودراسة الحالة المرضية بعمق. إجراء الفحص السريري الدقيق وطلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية. قراءة وتفسير النتائج والتقارير الطبية لتشخيص الحالة المرضية في موضوع التخصص بدقة. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية ومدى فاعلية الخطة العلاجية المتبعة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمريض وحفظها بشكل منظم ودقيق. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وذويهم. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم رعاية صحية متواصلة للمرضى. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في عنيزة، القصيم. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم مناقشته خلال مراحل المقابلة.

64801d724ed0d51c.description: Sales Leader, 3PL Provider eMagine Solutions is partnered with a rapidly expanding 3PL provider in Saudi Arabia to recruit a Sales Leader in Riyadh. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and focuses on new business acquisition within warehousing, contract logistics, and value-added services. A key objective is to consistently fill warehouse space and pallet positions. The role requires an entrepreneurial mindset, emphasizing ownership, rapid execution, and momentum building without extensive reliance on layered processes. Key Responsibilities Lead new business acquisition across warehousing, contract logistics, and value-added services. Manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, solution design, proposal development, negotiation, and closing. Focus on selling solutions by diagnosing operational pain points and constructing compelling commercial offers. Drive revenue through optimizing warehouse capacity and pallet positions, securing long-term contracts. Develop and maintain a robust sales pipeline, ensuring accurate forecasting and consistent activity levels. Engage with senior stakeholders, including General Managers, supply chain directors, procurement teams, and operations leadership. Collaborate closely with operations to ensure solutions are scalable, profitable, and executable. Lead and expand the sales team through coaching, hiring, performance management, and establishing a repeatable sales framework. Qualifications and Requirements Proven experience in 3PL, logistics, or contract logistics business development within Saudi Arabia. Strong track record in solution selling and consultative B2B sales. Demonstrated success in acquiring new clients and commercially filling warehouse capacity. Proactive attitude with an entrepreneurial mindset and high personal drive. Comfortable selling warehousing capacity, pallet positions, multi-site solutions, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and long-term contracts. Strong knowledge of the KSA market and an established network (sector background is flexible if sales capability is proven). Leadership capability, evidenced by prior team management or readiness to step into a leadership role. Commercial confidence in pricing, margin management, negotiation, and contract terms. 6499a30557e36178.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المباني السريعة للمقاولات عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية في مواقع العمل، والتحقيق في الحوادث، وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل لضمان الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. تسجيل نتائج التفتيش في السجلات المخصصة ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. تجهيز واستخدام معدات وأجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز. توثيق نتائج القياسات البيئية ومتابعة معالجة الأخطار الناجمة عنها مع الجهات المختصة. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيقات اللازمة، وتوثيق النتائج. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن، وتعليمات الإخلاء. توعية العاملين بالتعليمات والإجراءات المعتمدة لضمان سلامتهم. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية والخاصة، وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على متابعة وتطبيق اللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والتوثيق. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة حائل، وتتطلب الوظيفة التفرغ الكامل. سيعمل المشرف ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المنطقة: حائل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

64c5a6e7d4138836.description: About Air Products Qudra and the Role Air Products Qudra (APQ) is a joint venture between Saudi Aramco and Air Products Qudra, forming BHIG—Blue Hydrogen Industrial Gases. This entity focuses on driving industrial innovation and operational excellence, particularly in supporting clean energy goals through low-carbon hydrogen production. We are seeking an ASU Operator for a full-time position in Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia, to manage Field and DCS operations for the Air Separation Unit (ASU) and common area facilities. Role Overview and Responsibilities The ASU Operator, reporting to the ASU Shift Supervisor, will perform field and DCS operations for the ASU and common areas, including DM, CT, and ancillary units, independently. This role involves executing daily tasks, implementing safety procedures, and supporting maintenance and engineering teams. The operator will demonstrate expert knowledge in specified skill areas and contribute as a fully functioning member of the operations team, including taking a leadership role in TAR/Outages/Start-ups and training new operators. Perform Field and DCS operations for the ASU and Common Area facility. Prepare and implement safety work permits and LOTO procedures. Complete operations preventative maintenance activities. Assist maintenance and engineering teams with corrective maintenance activities. Operate ASU and ancillary equipment, including water treatment units, according to Work Instruction Procedures. Manage the pipeline network for hydrogen, steam, and CO2 supply, ensuring safe and efficient operations. Provide operational support and guidance during plant commissioning. Maintain accurate document control and monitor quality assurance initiatives. Manage plant production efficiently to meet safety, reliability, and profitability targets. Report shift production progress and plant status to the Shift Supervisor, offering operational solutions. Ensure compliance with process safety, MOC’s, and OPHR requirements. Operate the facility in compliance with environmental and regulatory requirements. Follow Site Work Instruction Manuals and other operating procedures to meet customer satisfaction. Execute shift turnover protocols for safe and efficient handover. Support maintenance and engineering teams in maintaining plant reliability and optimizing shutdown activities. Participate in investigations and Root Cause Analysis to implement sustainable corrective actions. Facilitate operational excellence and customer satisfaction through continuous improvement initiatives. Communicate plant activities across shifts to ensure continuity and safe operation. Safety Accountabilities Maintaining a safe work environment is a primary accountability for this role. The operator will demonstrate leadership in all company and industry safe work processes to prevent injuries and ensure proper documentation for safety-related activities. This includes utilizing the BHIG Basic Safety Practice program, encompassing Safety Work Permits, LOTO, and Confined Space procedures, to build and maintain a strong safety culture. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 6-10 years of experience in a relevant operational role. Demonstrated expert level of knowledge in specified skills areas. Solid technical knowledge of designated plant processes. Ability to operate independently on shift and contribute effectively to the operations team. Proficiency in writing SWIMs, JSAs, and other operational documents. Capability to take a leadership role in TAR/Outages/Start-ups. Experience in training new operators and participating in board reviews. Willingness to assist in startup and commissioning of new sites and training new workforce if required. Demonstrated in-depth knowledge of listed systems through task list completion. Work Environment and Expectations This full-time position is based in Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia, within the BHIG Company. The role requires a commitment to a 4S culture and practices to maintain a positive work environment. The operator will engage in continuous professional development and maintain close working relationships with engineering and maintenance personnel to monitor and evaluate plant systems and equipment. The position also involves maintaining customer communications to ensure demand rates are satisfied while maximizing facility efficiency and profitability.

Key responsibilities Lead a portfolio of development projects from feasibility through delivery readiness Define product strategy, unit mix, phasing and development briefs Drive feasibility, business planning and commercial optimisation Manage design, consultants, approvals and procurement strategy Represent the business in key stakeholder discussions Improve development processes across the portfolio Strong client-side residential development experience Proven capability across feasibility, product definition, design management and commercial decision-making A true developer mindset, not just project management Ability to balance product, design, cost, programme and profitability Strong stakeholder management across consultants, authorities and senior leadership Middle East experience preferred Developer backgrounds preferred over pure consultancy, contractor or PMC Relevant degree required; real estate or commercial qualifications are a plus

64fc64b0c378f30e.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking Field Service Engineers (FSEs) for full-time positions in Saudi Arabia. This role focuses on providing specialized field services for Medium Voltage (MV) Motors and/or Medium Voltage Variable Speed Drive (VSD/VFD) systems. The ideal candidate will possess hands-on experience in these areas and be capable of working independently on customer sites. Key Responsibilities Performing installation and commissioning of MV motor systems. Conducting testing and startup procedures for relevant equipment. Executing preventive and corrective maintenance tasks. Troubleshooting and repairing MV motor systems and associated control/protection systems. Candidate Profile We are particularly interested in candidates with direct hands-on experience in one or both of the following technical areas: Medium Voltage (MV) Motors. Medium Voltage Variable Speed Drive (VSD/VFD) systems. Prior field service or customer-site experience is preferred, along with the ability to work autonomously. Employment Terms The contract duration is 1 year, renewable. Working hours are 48 hours per week / 6 days per week. Overtime is available and paid. The company provides the necessary visa. The joining air ticket is provided by the company. Allowances for food, accommodation, and transportation will be provided in addition to the salary. The cost of GAMCA Medical and any required skill tests will be paid or reimbursed by the company. Compensation The salary for this position is open and negotiable, determined based on the candidate's experience and technical expertise.

6442072036be4539.description: About Tronox Tronox is a global leader in the vertically integrated manufacturing of titanium dioxide (TiO2) pigment and other materials that enhance the brightness and durability of everyday products. With a workforce of 5,700 individuals across six continents, Tronox is guided by a strong set of values. The company is dedicated to responsibly transforming earth's resources into products and opportunities that improve lives, with a vision to shape a sustainable world through enriched and refined minerals. The Role of Process Engineer Tronox is seeking a Process Engineer to join its team in Al Madinah, specifically in Yanbu or Medina. This full-time role is responsible for coordinating daily technical support and short-term technical improvements for SQLCST. The Process Engineer will focus on optimizing and designing processes to enhance efficiency, safety, and product quality sustainably. This involves analyzing production workflows, identifying bottlenecks, and implementing technical solutions to reduce costs and improve throughput. The role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with environmental and safety regulations while driving continuous improvement initiatives. Key Responsibilities Provide daily technical direction to the production department through general troubleshooting, monitoring process efficiency and product quality, and identifying process improvements. Take responsibility for all aspects of production, process, and metallurgical accounting, including completing daily, weekly, and monthly reports and interpreting data to identify improvement opportunities. Manage and coordinate improvements or small capital projects. Maintain and rigorously manage production data and databases. Identify any anomalies with the operation and maintenance of process control instrumentation and coordinate remedies as required. Required Qualifications and Skills 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Sound knowledge of mass balancing and reconciliation processes. Competence in data recording, trending, analysis, and interpretation, with a focus on improving all OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) levers. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Madinah, with primary locations in Yanbu and Medina. The role involves working within a global company that values sustainability and continuous improvement. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to contribute to Tronox's mission of shaping a sustainable world through refined minerals.

649938c41417ba53.description: About the Role HCLTech is seeking an Analyst (Support & Operations) to join their team in Riyadh, Ar Riyāḍ. This full-time position focuses on providing Level 1 remote desktop support and resolving assigned tickets in adherence to established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and quality standards. 64feb1bcb66079f1.description: About the Role ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail (AMTPJ) is seeking a Sr. Inspector, Electrical (Instrumentation & Automation) for the Heat Treatment and Finishing Line Expansion Project (HT+FL) in Al Jubail, Eastern Region. Supervise automation system testing, witnessing and approving factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT). Validate programmable logic controllers (PLC), distributed control systems (DCS), Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI), and emergency shutdown systems (ESD). Verify positive material identification (PMI), Vendor Quality dossiers, and OEM preservation procedures. Issue Project Non-Conformance Reports (NCR) for deviations and conduct technical root cause investigations using 5-Why or Fishbone frameworks. Lead field validation to close out corrective actions. Interface with project stakeholders, collaborating with Project Management, EPC contractors, and OEM automation site specialists to enforce quality standards. Technical expertise supervising field construction compliance, explosion-proof (ATEX/CompEx) installations, and signing off on automated loop checks. Solid track record conducting material receiving inspections, managing NCR lifecycles via 5-Why/Fishbone, and coordinating with EPCs, TPIAs, and OEMs. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail. Application Information Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

You'll have meaningful independence, but you're not expected to operate alone. You'll work alongside senior designers, Product Managers, Engineers, UX researchers, and UX writers. You'll take ownership from understanding the problem and defining the user experience through wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity UI, handoff, implementation, and post-launch iteration. Turn ambiguity into clarity. Requirements won't always arrive perfectly defined. You'll work with Product, Engineering, Research, and stakeholders to understand the underlying problem and determine what we actually need to solve. Design for outcomes, not outputs. You'll challenge solutions that don't clearly improve the customer's experience and use research, data, and customer feedback to understand whether your designs are actually working. Partner closely with Product and Engineering. You'll be involved early rather than receiving requirements at the end of the process. You'll help shape what gets built and work through technical and product constraints without losing sight of the customer. Raise the quality of our products. You'll contribute to Lucidya's design system and help create consistency across our products while knowing when a problem requires something different. Bring customer evidence into design decisions. You'll conduct or support usability testing and lightweight research, using what you learn to validate assumptions rather than relying solely on personal opinion. Make complex products feel simple. Whether you're designing analytics, workflows, AI functionality, or customer-facing experiences, you'll look for ways to reduce cognitive load and help users get to the outcome they need faster. Design thoughtfully for our market. You'll account for Arabic and English experiences, RTL considerations, and the needs of enterprise customers across the region. Communicate your thinking clearly. You'll present work to Product, Engineering, leadership, and other stakeholders, explaining not only what you designed but why you made those decisions. Make the team better. You'll actively participate in critiques, give thoughtful feedback to other designers, and share what you've learned rather than keeping your knowledge within your own product area. Who You Are You can own a problem without needing someone to tell you every step. You know how to take an ambiguous brief, ask the right questions, break it down, and move it forward. You think like a product designer, not just a UI designer. You're interested in the customer, the business problem, the constraints, and the outcome — not simply whether the final interface looks polished. You're comfortable challenging the status quo. If you think a requirement doesn't make sense or there's a better way to solve a problem, you're willing to say so and can back your thinking with evidence. You know when to push and when to compromise. You can defend an important design decision while understanding that product development involves technical, commercial, and time constraints. You're highly collaborative. You don't throw designs over the wall to Engineering or wait for Product to tell you what to do. You work with people throughout the process. You're comfortable with ambiguity and change. Priorities may shift, requirements may evolve, and not every decision will be made for you. You stay focused on the outcome rather than becoming frustrated by the process. You're genuinely curious about users. You want to understand why customers behave the way they do and are willing to change your design when the evidence tells you that your original assumption was wrong. You communicate with clarity. You can explain complex design decisions to people who aren't designers and can adapt how you communicate depending on whether you're speaking with an Engineer, Product Manager, customer, or executive. You care about quality. You have high standards for interaction, usability, accessibility, and visual design, but you also understand when “good enough to learn” is better than spending weeks perfecting something nobody has validated. You have 3–5 years of product design or UX/UI experience , ideally in B2B or SaaS environments, with a portfolio demonstrating genuine end-to-end product thinking. You're proficient in Figma and comfortable with prototyping, design systems, and modern product design practices. You're a Saudi national , as this position is designated for Saudi nationals. Nice to Have Experience designing data-heavy or analytics-driven B2B products. Experience with AI-powered products, conversational interfaces, or AI agents. Experience designing Arabic/English or RTL experiences. Familiarity with tools such as FigJam, Maze, LogRocket, or similar research and testing tools. What the hiring process will look like Recruiter screening — An initial conversation about your experience, motivations, and what you're looking for next. Design interview — A deeper discussion with the Design team around your product thinking, design process, and approach to solving complex problems. Portfolio / case study presentation — You'll take us through selected projects, focusing on the problem, your role, decisions, trade-offs, collaboration, and measurable or observable outcomes. Team / culture interview — A conversation focused on how you work, give and receive feedback, handle disagreement, and contribute to a high-performing team. Final interview — Final conversation with the relevant leadership team.
